title: Krupa and Buddy Rich at Jazz at the Philharmonic
summary: Norvo saw Buddy Rich, with far superior technique, refrain from outplaying Gene Krupa, producing emotional heights.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why
